about: The control ledger (UI_RULES §128). Every clickable control family in app/src is either a kit family (it wears one of the kit classes below) or classified here with a role and the reason. app/scripts/control-families.mjs enumerates the families; test-control-ledger.mjs (CI) fails an unclassified family, a stale entry, or a kit class that is not documented. A new bespoke control therefore fails CI until it adopts a kit class or is written down here, where review sees it.

roles.row: A list row, a rich menu row or a section header: the row is the tap target, and its list sets its layout.
roles.card: A clickable card or tile: its face is a card, not a button.
roles.nav: App chrome and navigation: the sidebar, the phone's floating nav, the bell, the search trigger, the Messages launcher.
roles.variant: A kit control's documented variant under its own class.
roles.exception: A one-off with a reason it cannot be a kit control.

kit..btn: UI_RULES §115: the action button, 32px, with a colour role.
kit..btn.btn-sm: UI_RULES §115: 28px, only in data-table rows and the named dense clusters.
kit..btn.btn-link: UI_RULES §126: the text button (the 32px box, muted text).
kit..btn-icon: UI_RULES §123: the icon-only square, 28px (40 on phones); plain, -ghost, -danger or -primary.
kit..modal-close: UI_RULES §123: a surface's close, the 28px grey circle (40 on phones).
kit..chip-remove: UI_RULES §123: the × inside a chip or pill.
kit..input-clear: UI_RULES §123: the clear inside a search field (20px).
kit..thumb-remove: UI_RULES §123: the round × on a thumbnail's corner.
kit..tab-btn: UI_RULES §7: a segment of a tab bar (one segmented recipe, three names).
kit..segmented-btn: UI_RULES §7: a segment of an inline segmented control.
kit..inbox-toggle-btn: UI_RULES §7: a segment of Messaging's inbox toggle (the dock's too).
kit..chip: UI_RULES §124: the clickable pill, 32px (.chip-sm 28), black when on.
kit..select-trigger: UI_RULES §109: the field trigger every picker opens from.
kit..menu-option: UI_RULES §127: a row in a dropdown or popover menu.
kit..linklike: UI_RULES §126: a link inside running text.
kit..badge-trigger: A status badge that opens its menu (the customer status, a key's status).

.nav-btn.why: The sidebar's navigation rows (the dark rail; THEME_CLEANSPACE R7).

.sidebar-footer-btn.why: The sidebar footer's action (Report an issue), styled with the rail.

.user-chip.why: The sidebar's user switcher chip: who is signed in, and the sandbox view switch.

.nav-review.why: The client-review marker on a nav row (In review / Approved): a span[role=button] inside the NavLink, so it cannot nest a real button.

.bell-btn.why: The round black notifications bell in the top bar (44px in Messaging's phone header, UI_RULES §115).

.msearch-trigger.why: The phone's global-search trigger in the top bar (UI_RULES §116).

.msearch-back.why: The search overlay's back arrow, sized to the overlay's search field (UI_RULES §116).

.cs-msg-launcher.why: The Messages dock's floating launcher pill with its unread badge.

.cs-fnav-menu-btn.why: The phone floating nav's menu button: the brand book's one liquid-glass surface.

.cs-fnav-mitem.why: A destination in the phone floating nav's menu.

.cs-fnav-puck.why: The phone floating nav's condensed puck (scroll to top and refresh).

.cs-fnav-scrim.why: The scrim behind the phone floating nav's menu; tapping it closes the menu.

.cs-fnav-tab.why: A tab of the phone floating nav (the gold pill when on).

.thread-row.why: A conversation in Messaging's thread list; the row is the tap target (its star and menu are .btn-icon).

.cs-msg-conv.why: A conversation in the Messages dock's list.

.bell-item-btn.why: A notification in the bell's list (its dismiss is a quiet .btn-icon).

.mnotif-open.why: A notification in the bell's mobile triage sheet (MobileNotificationList); the row is the tap target, dismiss and mark-read are swipe gestures.

.followup-row.why: A follow-up on the admin dashboard.

.myday-upcoming-item.why: An upcoming clean on the crew's My Day.

.pay-flag.why: A flagged line on Payroll's review view.

.pay-rrow.why: A person on Payroll's roster view; it opens their line drawer.

.pay-wstep.why: A step of Payroll's wizard view.

.dlp-rail-i.why: An account in the account dashboard's rail (layout C: the owner's home, and its preview in the layout picker).

.msearch-opt.why: A global-search result: icon, label and where it lives (UI_RULES §116).

.msgmenu-row.why: A channel row in the message contact menu: icon, label and value in a grid.

.newconv-row.why: A contact in New conversation's picker: avatar, name, reachability and tags in a five-column grid.

.dm-picker-row.why: A teammate in the New DM picker (avatar rows with dividers).

.crew-picker-row.why: A crew member in CrewPicker's list (avatar and name).

.participant-add-row.why: A person in the conversation panel's Add participant list (avatar and name).

.contact-picker-option.why: A contact or company in the pickers' lists (avatar, name and email).

.qs-card-head.why: The header of a QuickStart guide card: it expands the card (an accordion).

.rp-title.why: The header of a Roles section: it expands the section (an accordion).

.uninvoiced-head.why: The header of the Invoices page's uninvoiced-cleans section: it expands the section.

<button> in components/GmailConnectInstr.why: The "How to connect Gmail" header of a disclosure inside three connect modals (an accordion).

.activity-card.why: A clean or an invoice on the customer's Activity tab; the card opens it.

.pay-card.why: A person's card on HR Employees and Payroll's register.

.pipeline-card.why: A deal on the Pipeline board (it drags; a click opens it).

.card.why: A reply on Marketing's Replies tab; the card opens it (Marketing is dormant).

.qa-btn.why: A quick-action tile on the admin dashboard (icon over label).

.review-tile.why: A hub tile in the Review section (a decision section, or the drafts area): its face is a card with a progress ring, and a click opens focus mode (UI_RULES §130).

.media-item.why: A site photo's thumbnail; it opens the viewer (its × is .thumb-remove).

.msearch-lp-tile.why: A create tile on the global search's launchpad (UI_RULES §116).

.msearch-lp-page.why: A page shortcut on the global search's launchpad (UI_RULES §116).

.dlp-vtab.why: A layout choice card in the dashboard and payroll layout pickers (letter, name and description; review-only).

.wo-seg.why: A stat on Work Orders' command bar; the big number filters the list, like a stat card.

.rp-toggle.why: The Toggle's three-state form (on, off, mixed) in the Roles grid, at the Toggle's 36×20.

.wo-toggle.why: Work Orders' "Group by location": a labelled switch, the kit toggle's track inside a text button.

.media-viewer-nav.why: The photo viewer's ‹ › arrows: 40px rounds over the image, so they read on any photo.

.thread-title-btn.why: Click-to-edit conversation title: the title text is the control, with a pencil on hover.

.marketing-flow-wait.why: The wait step on a sequence's flow line: a connector between two step cards (Marketing is dormant).

<button> in components/ErrorBoundary.jsx.why: The crash screen's Reload: it styles itself inline because it renders when the app's own components have failed.

<button> in pages/settings/TeamDetail.js.why: The permissions grid's override badge-button. S101's in-flight CS-355 change owns TeamDetail.jsx, so it is classified here and left unchanged.
